description: This file defines a final class 'JSON' that provides utility methods for creating JSON objects from various data sources, converting JSON to objects, and handling JSON strings. It uses Jackson's ObjectMapper for serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: JSON
classes.description: A utility class for handling JSON serialization and deserialization, providing static factory methods and instance methods for JSON string management.

methods.name: from(InputStream)
methods.description: Creates a JSON object from an InputStream, assuming UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: from(Object)
methods.description: Creates a JSON object from a generic Java object by serializing it to a JSON string.

methods.name: from(Reader)
methods.description: Creates a JSON object from a Reader source.

methods.name: from(String)
methods.description: Creates a JSON object from a JSON string.

methods.name: toObject(Class<T>)
methods.description: Converts the JSON string to an object of the specified class.
